hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A 1:1 ETH/phiEth swap hook implementing a custom constant-price curve via `beforeSwapReturnsDelta`. On each swap, it takes input from the PoolManager, converts via `phiEth.deposit`/`withdraw`, and settles output — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Liquidity addition is blocked; only ETH/phiEth pools with zero fee are accepted.
